sn35.1:1.1: Saṃyutta-Nikāya Namo tassa Bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa || || 1 Evaṃ me sutaṃ ||
sn35.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
sn35.1:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 3
sn35.1:2.4: yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbam || || 4
sn35.1:2.18: yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 9
sn35.1:2.19: Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati || sotasmimpi- || ghānasmimpi- || jivhāya pi- || kāyasmim pi- || manasmim pi nibbindati ||
sn35.1:2.20: nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || Vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamhīti ñāṇam hoti || ||
sn35.1:2.21: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || 3
